meta.query_interpretation: Count rheumatoid arthritis trials by start year for studies that began in 2015 or later.

plan.interpretation: Count rheumatoid arthritis trials by start year for studies that began in 2015 or later.

assumptions: Study start dates with month or day precision are bucketed by calendar year.
Every year in the range is listed; years with no trials have trial_count 0.
5 trials have anticipated start dates after 2026 (2027–2028); registries record planned start dates, so these trials have not started yet.
2026 is in progress, so its count is not final.
All 1,972 matching trials were analyzed, so counts are exact registry totals.
